researchRepository.permissionCopy: GitHub permission was lost for this repository. Reconnect GitHub after restoring access. The workspace remains readable, but writes are disabled.
researchRepository.publicCopy: Read-only: repository is public. Writes are disabled until the repository is private again.
researchRepository.repositoryChanged: The repository changed while you were editing.
researchRepository.trustCopy: The app uses your GitHub token only to read and write artifacts confined to the repository's mapped layout directory — the openrigor/ prefix on current repositories; older repositories use a root-level layout that is read-only. It does not browse or modify anything outside that mapped layout. Disconnect or uninstall deletes tokens stored here. GitHub keeps the repository under its own control. Reconnecting is a new grant. If the repo is deleted, recreate or re-add it and re-grant access. If a branch is deleted or force-pushed, recover it on GitHub, then reconcile or reseed from a sealed layout.
researchRepository.unavailableCopy: Repository unavailable (deleted or access removed). Restore by recreating or re-adding the repository, then re-grant the GitHub App. For a deleted or force-pushed branch, recover it on GitHub, then reconcile — or reseed from a sealed layout.
